upstream.name: alphafold3-open
upstream.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE in the archive; weights terms in WEIGHTS_TERMS_OF_USE.md apply to AlphaFold 3 parameters only, which this tree never uses)
upstream.build: docker/Dockerfile: FROM nvidia/cuda:12.6.3-base-ubuntu24.04; python3.12; uv 0.9.24; uv sync --frozen --all-groups --no-editable (uv.lock, 105 packages); uv run build_data; HMMER 3.4

patches.what: with --of3_weights, absent (padding) template slots are featurised as GAP (OpenFold3's convention) instead of restype 0 (ALA) in SingleTemplateEmbedding; gated on global_config.of3_weights
patches.kind: correctness (OF3-weights port; not a speed optimization)
patches.note: declared exception to stock==upstream: applied at image build AND present in stock/src, so every arm (off included) carries it — upstream AF3-JAX never runs OF3 weights and so never needs this fix
patches.source: STOCK.md 'The stock exception' (issue, fix, measured effect, upstream PR text); Apache-2.0
patches.applies: patch -p1 in the archive root (alphafold3-bc32b22f/), alone on the pinned commit

wheel.what: the stock distribution as installed in the tested stack, packed as a wheel: this archive's source at the pinned commit with upstream.patches applied, its C++ extension alphafold3/cpp.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so compiled by upstream's own build (scikit-build-core + CMake, gcc 13.3.0, Ubuntu 24.04; abseil-cpp, pybind11, pybind11_abseil, libcifpp v7.0.3 and dssp v4.4.7 fetched at the tags CMakeLists.txt pins) and the wwPDB Chemical Component Dictionary snapshot libcifpp fetched at that build (share/libcifpp/components.cif, 2026-08-09, sha256 8aba80443a10f38f972f55260b6acc64d8bf5a5320ddf7d5b49716c9b69088aa; 50,885 CCD codes) — environment/Dockerfile installs it with --no-deps into /alphafold3_venv and runs upstream's build_data after it; not in git: placed in stock/wheels/ (STOCK.md 'Install')
wheel.build_yourself: upstream's documented build makes an equivalent wheel from stock/src (patch applied): `pip wheel --no-deps .` (or `uv build --wheel`) in the checkout on the environment/ stack — its CCD snapshot is then the one wwPDB serves on your build day, and the compiled extension's bytes differ; every mode runs either, the digests here describe the tested one

image.tested_on: the image environment/Dockerfile builds — upstream's docker/Dockerfile layout (Ubuntu 24.04, the CUDA 12.6.3 base image, Python 3.12.1, uv 0.9.24, the stock environment /alphafold3_venv, the checkout /app/alphafold) with upstream.wheel as the installed stock (upstream.patches inside it and applied to the checkout); NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, driver 580.95.05 — a documentation line, nothing compares against it

freeze.what: the pinned stack: every distribution of the stock interpreter but stock itself (upstream.wheel), `name==version` lines; stock/check_pins.py compares the interpreter with it

converted.converter_run: convert_of3_weights.py (the stock script; stock/PINS.json stock_files) on the public checkpoint, in the pinned image (torch 2.7.1+cpu)

converter: convert_of3_weights.py --of3_checkpoint <checkpoint> --output_dir <dir> — the stock script of the checkout (stock/PINS.json stock_files), run by python -m af3_jax_opt.convert

hardware.gate: device memory >= 24 GB and compute capability >= 8.0 (bf16 flash attention; the kit's tested GPUs are H100/H200/A100 80 GB, opt/forward/fast_inference/HOWTO.md §1); the constants live in af3_jax_opt/stack.py
